key_highlights: ASX slumps ~1% as oil surges past $US109 (highest since May), dragging miners and banks lower; bond yields surge
AUD sharply weaker on growth scare; 'AUD shocker' risk flagged by macrobusiness
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices crash while first-home buyers surge; RBA flags rental inflation concern
Geopolitical oil risk elevated: Houthis threaten Red Sea Saudi exports; US strikes on Iranian tankers
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic stress concerns
Australian business confidence deteriorating; Woolworths breaches own 'Price Freeze' on staples
Albo government softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears; Flagship ups copper exposure
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid; data centre buildout at coal plants signals energy transition demand

sectors.trend: Bearish short-term. Oil spike to $US109+ and surging bond yields pressure energy names; however, copper strength (Flagship) and gold exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) provide selective upside. BHP faces class action over public holiday work. Chinese inflation surge may dampen iron ore demand.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from yield-driven risk-off. Copper-exposed names (Flagship) and gold juniors (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer relative strength. Monitor iron ore demand signal from Chinese CPI.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and growth scare hit bank valuations. Bathla private credit collapse raises credit-risk concerns. RBA rental inflation worry complicates rate path. NSW stamp duty revenue hit pressures state-linked exposures.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from yield curve steepening and credit stress. Private credit exposure (Bathla) warrants portfolio review.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Oil at $US109+ benefits upstream producers but raises input costs. Albo softens gas reservation, easing LNG supply fears for Asian buyers. Data centre demand at coal plants (Power giant) signals structural energy demand.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from gas policy shift. Coal-to-data-centre transition supports energy infrastructure names.

sectors.trend: Under pressure. Woolworths breaches Price Freeze on four staples, eroding consumer trust. Business confidence deteriorating. Housing correction may boost first-home buyer spending but high-end crash hurts luxury retail.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin and sentiment headwinds. Defensive consumer staples may attract rotation from cyclical names.

sectors.trend: Divergent. High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. RBA rental inflation concern may prompt policy response. Fixed mortgage rates inching up (5/1 ARM >7%) pressures borrower affordability.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (e.g., GPT.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield compression risk. First-home buyer surge supports residential construction names.

sectors.trend: Constructive. 25 proposed new data centres and coal-plant repurposing signal strong AI/energy demand. Cathie Wood's Cerebras bet signals global tech appetite. However, rising rates pressure long-duration tech valuations.
sectors.implications: Data centre and power infrastructure names benefit. ASX-listed tech remains thin; global tech (Cerebras, TE Connectivity) provides thematic context.

key_themes: Oil spike to $US109+ driven by Houthi Red Sea threats and US-Iran tanker strikes; TACO (Trump And Chill Oil) dynamics
AUD weakness and growth scare; 'AUD shocker' risk if RBA forced into hawkish hold
Housing market bifurcation: high-end crash vs. first-home buyer surge; RBA rental inflation focus
Private credit stress (Bathla) as potential systemic contagion channel
Commodity complex: copper strength, gold exploration, gas policy liberalisation
Consumer confidence erosion: business fears, Woolworths price freeze breach, rising mortgage rates
Energy transition: data centres at coal sites, battery tech (Critical Resources), copper demand

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical oil shock (Houthi Red Sea / US-Iran)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor Brent/WTI; consider oil-linked ETFs as tactical hedge
Reduce AUD-denominated risk; favour export-oriented miners; monitor RBA commentary
Review bank and fund exposure to private credit; favour large-cap banks with transparent lending
Underweight luxury property REITs; favour affordable-segment and construction plays

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy dilemma (rental inflation vs. growth)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Position for potential hawkish hold; monitor CPI and rental data releases
Diversify away from China-exposed iron ore/coal; favour copper and gold

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight copper-exposed miners and gold explorers
opportunities.rationale: Copper at multi-year highs; Flagship expanding Canadian stakes; Kuniko and Gateway WA gold-silver systems active; gold as inflation hedge amid oil spike

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on LNG/gas producers post-policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Albo softens gas reservation, easing Asian supply fears; structural data centre energy demand supports gas-fired generation

opportunities.recommendation: Position in defensive consumer staples and first-home buyer beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: Housing bifurcation: high-end crash but first-home buyer surge; Woolworths price pressure supports volume-driven staples rotation
M&A catalyst; shipbuilding sector benefits from global naval rearmament and LNG carrier demand

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap bank exposure; favour quality over yield
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla private credit contagion, rising yields, and growth scare pressure NIMs and credit costs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with commodity-linked or USD-denominated exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'shocker' risk; growth scare and oil import bill pressure currency

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight high-end property REITs and luxury retail
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; fixed mortgage rates >7% squeeze borrower capacity

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil above $US109, surging bond yields, AUD weakness, and private credit stress create a risk-off backdrop. Miners and banks lead declines. Selective upside in copper, gas, and gold. RBA policy dilemma (rental inflation vs. growth) adds uncertainty. Expect elevated volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and Chinese demand stabilises. Structural themes: data centre buildout, energy transition (coal-to-gas/renewables), copper supercycle, and first-home buyer housing cycle. RBA likely to pivot to cuts if growth scare materialises, supporting equities. Key risk: prolonged geopolitical oil shock or private credit contagion.
key_catalysts: RBA rate decision and rental inflation commentary
Oil price trajectory (Houthi/Iran escalation or de-escalation)
Chinese CPI and demand data (iron ore/coal impact)
Bathla private credit resolution and contagion spread
Australian CPI and employment data (growth scare validation)
watch_list: Iron ore and copper spot prices
